items.text: Sam Gallucci is a former business executive who served as the senior pastor of Embrace Church in Oxnard. Before becoming a pastor, he worked as an executive at IBM. He was an executive vice president and general manager at the software company PeopleSoft. He helped found several nonprofit organizations, including the Kingdom Center, which provides emergency housing and transitional living for women and children, and Treasured Harvest, which provides food aid and resources to farmworkers.

items.text: Gallucci calls for investment in wildfire fuel reduction, forest management, and resilient power infrastructure, and supports increased federal funding for wildfire prevention conditioned on the responsible management of resources. On immigration, he supports a legal system at the border, funding the mass removal of violent offenders who are in the country illegally, streamlining work permits in fields with labor shortages, and expanding anti-trafficking task forces. He has stated he will fight to make Ventura County affordable for all.
